profile.headline: How can I help? 😊 | Full Stack Engineer | Consultant | Software
profile.summary: Anthony Messerschmidt is a senior consultant and lead software engineer with 10 years of experience developing software. He has been a part of many different teams taking on roles such as software developer, product owner, software engineer, cloud architect, systems architect, and project lead. Anthony has experience doing front end development, backend development, database design and implementation, and cloud infrastructure as well as some technical writing and design documents. One of his specialties is full stack development. During his career he has worked in many different industries with a range of organizations from startups to fortune 500 and fortune 1000 companies. His recent forays into entrepreneurship is helping develop his leadership talents and business acumen.

positions.title: Senior Consultant
positions.description: Backed by Bain Capital Double Impact, Sparq is the leading U.S.-based digital engineering consultancy for building, deploying and supporting digital applications, products and experiences. Sparq assembles trusted software engineering teams that collaboratively solve challenges with creativity and rigor. Our experts know how to work together—with each other and with clients—generating momentum, velocity and success.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Consultant with Omni to help with all your software development needs.

positions.title: Programmer Intern
positions.description:
Summer 2014 – Programmer Analyst Intern
	--Performed maintenance on business critical applications such as customer billing
	--Engineered and delivered an application to manage the database tables used by another application
	--Created requirements document, design document, and various UML diagrams
	--Developed using C#,  WPF,  MVVM,  .NET,  XAML,  SQL,  Visual Studio,  TFS

Summer 2013 – Programmer Analyst Intern
	--Assisted in migrating old outdated servers to new servers
	--Developed a new directory exclusion feature for a source code searching tool
	--Designed and implemented a new application used to update/install other applications/websites
	--Capable of deploying an application to multiple locations simultaneously including servers
	--Installed a new database to support the application I engineered
	--Created requirements document, design doc. (class diagram, ERD, GUI Prototype), and a user guide
	--Programmed using C#,  Windows Forms Application,  .NET,  SQL,  Visual Studio,  and TFS


Worked on several projects where I was the lead programmer.

One major project I designed and implemented was a C# software product for enhancing productivity of deploying the company's various applications. It utilizes a database to save information needed to deploy applications. I followed a detailed software design process which resulted in several deliverables including: UML class diagrams, entity relationship diagrams, requirements documentation, GUI prototype, a user manual, and the fully tested working software application.

positions.title: Student Clerk
positions.description:
Summer 2012 – Student Clerk 
	--Created new SQL reports for various business units in the company
	--Updated and fixed existing SQL reports while making them faster and more efficient
	--Developed with Microsoft SQL Server Management Studio, SSRS, Visual Studio, and TFS

projects.title: SimpleOCR
projects.description:
SimpleOCR – Personal research project
--A general purpose Optical Character Recognition software system 
--Converts images of documents into fully editable text
--Written in Java using Eclipse
